name: RegionContrast supervision for SAM2 memory Q/K
status: frozen before gate and full CV; exploratory post-result PolypGen study
motivation: Earlier regional adapters and prototypes did not establish a region-specific gain. RegionContrast proposes class-wise region centers in a memory bank. This adaptation uses predicted-mask foreground-interior, mixed-boundary and background token centers as contrastive memory for SAM2's existing memory-attention projections.

RegionContrast.paper: Region-Aware Contrastive Learning for Semantic Segmentation
RegionContrast.reused_code: The author construct_region method forms class-wise feature centers. The training queue and paper-equation contrast are integrated with SAM2 projected Q/K features.
RegionContrast.implementation_note: The cloned repository's _compute_contrast_loss forms elementwise channel products and applies cross-entropy over channels, unlike the paper's dot-product InfoNCE Eq. 4. This candidate uses the paper equation with normalized region centers and documents the deviation; it does not call that inconsistent helper.

SAM2.reused_code: Native SAM2 track_step, mask and object-presence losses, four memory-attention Q/K projections and dense attention path.

method.token_roles: Fixed v1 mixed-cell regions derived from each frame's own stored native 256x256 predicted mask on the 64x64 memory grid.
method.region_centers: Use the pinned RegionContrast construct_region mean feature center, with a device-portability adaptation for CPU/MPS. Extract one center per role and per memory frame.
method.contrast: At each read and each of four memory layers, query role centers are contrasted against same-role memory centers and that role's training queue; other roles are negatives. Use normalized dot-product InfoNCE from RegionContrast paper Eq. 4, temperature 0.2, mean role loss, weight 0.1. Queue capacity is 2975 per role and per layer; queues start empty and reset per fold.
method.trainable: Only SAM2 cross-attention q_proj and k_proj in the four memory-attention layers. No new learned adapter is added.
method.control: Matched Q/K-only arm with same fold, random seed, sampled clips, initialization, optimizer, training steps and SAM2 mask/presence loss; contrastive weight is zero.
method.inference: Use trained Q/K parameters in the unmodified dense SAM2 attention path. Every native memory frame, spatial token, pointer, memory write, image encoder and decoder remains active. No good/bad-frame selection, attention gate, token pruning or inference threshold is used.
method.labels: Region labels are generated from SAM2 predicted masks, never ground-truth masks. Ground truth is used only for the standard training loss and evaluation.

data.independence: Sequence-grouped exploratory cross-validation. PolypGen informed prior method development; patient-to-sequence independence is unverified.

training.sampler: Pinned SAM2 RandomUniformSampler; forward consecutive clips with positive prompt conditioning.
training.loss: Pinned SAM2 autoregressive mask Dice/BCE plus object-presence loss, with 0.1 times RegionContrast loss in the candidate arm.

evaluation.design: Three sequence-grouped folds; each eligible sequence is evaluated once out of fold in full propagation.
evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean of each sequence's present-frame Dice.
secondary: four-layer trace and spatial/pointer key counts
evaluation.screen_vs_native: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice, positive delta on at least 14/21 sequences, and no increase in pooled GT-empty false alarms.
evaluation.region_attribution_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice over matched Q/K-only, wins on at least 14/21 sequences, and no increase in GT-empty false alarms versus Q/K-only.
evaluation.scope: Exploratory PolypGen evidence only; not independent confirmation.

decision: Run focused CPU tests and a real-sequence engineering gate before full CV. The gate must confirm zero-update native identity, finite nonzero Q/K and contrast gradients, all four layers, valid region centers, and exact spatial/pointer accounting. If the gate passes, run the frozen CV once. Do not tune from its validation results.
